scope: isolated P1 recovery, long-session and resource acceptance

checks: 4096 context teardown cycles without RSS growth
input remains responsive during continuous updates
next key remains responsive after SDK batch commit
256 FocusIn calls without compositor query or FD leak
timeout recovery resumes a new composition
crashed engine restarts and typing continues
Rime restart restores the application input mode

limitations: real multi-monitor and mixed-DPI hardware were not tested
long-run hardware p99 latency was not established
